The '''MediCure Laboratories''' was a research facility operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-affiliated company [[MediCure Pharmaceuticals]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was located in the [[Republic Research Division]] of the [[Ternion Building]].<ref name="TOR:BtC" />
